About these terms

These terms are an agreement between you and [business name, ABN] ("Plaeta", "we", "us") about using the Plaeta app and website. By creating an account or using Plaeta you agree to them. Our privacy policy explains how we handle your information.

Who can use Plaeta

  • You must be at least 13 years old. Plaeta is made for students aged about 16 to 18.
  • If you are under 18, you need a parent or carer's permission to use Plaeta, and they should read these terms with you.
  • The details you give us, including your date of birth, must be true.

The free test phase

Before launch, Plaeta is offered as a free test version, for testers aged 18 and over. It has no accounts or payments, saves your work only in your own browser, and uses Google Gemini's free tier, under Google's terms. It may change, break or lose data without notice, so keep your own copies of anything important.

Your account

  • Your account is for you alone. Do not share your login or let others use your account.
  • Keep your password safe and tell us straight away if you think someone else has used your account.

Cost and fair use

  • Free to use. Plaeta is free. There are no plans, subscriptions or payments, and every feature is included.
  • Monthly limits. To keep Plaeta free for everyone, each student has a monthly limit on past paper uploads and on AI essay marking. Settings shows how much you have used. Limits start again on the 1st of each month.
  • How papers are counted. A paper counts toward your monthly limit when you upload it. If Plaeta cannot read a paper because of its own error, it goes back to your limit. Unused papers do not carry over to the next month.

Your uploads

  • You keep ownership of everything you add: your notes, answers and files. You give us permission to store and process them only to provide Plaeta to you.
  • Only upload what you are allowed to use. Upload syllabuses, past papers and marking guidelines that you are entitled to use for your own study. Plaeta does not supply past papers or syllabuses.
  • Private by design. Your uploads are visible only to you and are never shared with other students.
  • Papers are deleted after 60 days. Uploaded papers, their page images and question text are deleted automatically 60 days after upload. Your answers, marks, notes and progress stay.
  • We may remove content that breaks these terms or the law.

AI marking

Plaeta uses AI to read papers, mark answers and suggest what to study. AI marking is a study aid. It can be wrong, it is not an official mark, and it does not predict or guarantee your results. Always check AI feedback against your course's marking criteria, and treat your teacher's marks and advice as the final word.

Academic honesty

Use Plaeta to learn and practise. Do not use it to produce work that you hand in as your own for an assessment, or in any way your school or exam rules do not allow. You are responsible for following those rules.

Using Plaeta fairly

You must not:

  • upload anything unlawful, sexual, hateful, threatening, or that invades someone's privacy;
  • upload other people's personal information;
  • try to get around the monthly limits, safety filters or security, or access anyone else's data;
  • copy, scrape, resell or reverse engineer Plaeta, or use automated tools to access it;
  • use Plaeta to harass or harm anyone.

We may suspend or close an account that breaks these rules. Where it is fair to do so, we will warn you first.

Availability and changes

We work to keep Plaeta running and your data safe, but we cannot promise it will always be available or free of errors. We may improve or change features over time. If a change takes away something important, we will tell you in advance.

Our responsibility to you

Under the Australian Consumer Law you have consumer guarantees that cannot be excluded, including that our services will be supplied with due care and skill. Nothing in these terms takes away those rights. Where the law allows, our responsibility for a failure to meet a guarantee is limited to supplying the service again or refunding what you paid for the affected period. Otherwise, to the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for indirect loss, such as an exam result.

Ending your account

You can close your account at any time in Settings. Before you do, you can download all your data. When you close your account we delete your data as set out in the privacy policy.

Law and disputes

These terms are governed by the law of [state], Australia. If you have a problem, please contact us first so we can try to fix it. You can also contact your state's consumer protection agency.

Changes to these terms

If we change these terms in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app at least 30 days before the change applies. If you do not agree, you can stop using Plaeta and close your account before then.
